title: twb-foundry spec v1
description: Contract between the HTML->spec step (LLM) and the deterministic .twbx generator. Structural rules live here; data-dependent rules (field exists, numeric for SUM, date for line) are checked by the builder against the CSV.

locale.description: The workbook's locale (<workbook locale>, File > Workbook Locale): grouping and decimal marks, month and day names on any machine. From the HTML's <html lang> (outline.locale: ru* -> ru_RU, else en_US); without it en_US (decisions/085). A CSV with ISO dates or none is read in it too; DD.MM / MM/DD dates keep the text-file locale their order needs.

name.description: The source's name: sheets[].datasource and calcs[].datasource refer to it

datasources.description: Several independent data sources (decisions/083), instead of 'datasource': each is a datasource of the workbook with its own file; a sheet takes exactly one (sheets[].datasource, default the first), no blending or relationships. A calc belongs to calcs[].datasource (default the first), a filter to its show_on sheet's source, fields to every source that has the column

title.description: Dashboard header, 24pt; wrap key words in ** to make only them bold ('**Regions** Overview'), otherwise the whole title is bold

subtitle.description: Grey line under the dashboard title: period, source, 'Data updated: ...'; colored words as in a sheet subtitle ({accent:East}), for colors some sheet draws

grid.description: Rows top-to-bottom; each row lists cells left-to-right. A cell is a sheet name, {sheet, width} or a group {rows, width, row_heights} with its own grid (nesting up to 3 levels); widths are relative weights (default 1)

row_heights.description: Relative row weights, one per grid row (default: equal)

oneOf.description: Left panel (grey) with the dashboard title, filter dropdowns and legends, instead of the header row and the right-hand panel

theme.description: Look of the blocks, default 'cards' (decisions/168); 'flat' is the plain look without cards, and the only one a sidebar, a topbar or block_headers false can have. Card theme (decisions/030): grey canvas #f5f5f5, every block a white card with a 1px #e6e6e6 border and padding 12, 16px apart; the theme's type scale (title 18, block 12, KPI 24 up to 3 in a row / 18, chart text and column titles 8pt; decisions/089). Without it the dashboard is drawn as before

card_border.description: Theme 'cards': false draws the cards without their 1px border, told from the canvas by their white face only (decisions/089)

theme_font.description: Workbook font for every text (style-rule element='all'); default Tableau's own (Tableau Book)

accent.description: The book's accent instead of the house #4e79a7 (decisions/137): highlight, the dark end of a sequential scale (heatmap, bar, map), symbol map circles, KPI, nav line, reference line flags, registry bars, scatter, benchmark. One value for all dashboards; lint C7 warns when it is near good / bad, C8 checks white text on it (bar_inside)

data_as_of.description: A date column: 'Data as of <its latest date>' at the right of the dashboard header (decisions/037; needs a dashboard title, no sidebar)

filter_toggle.description: A Show/Hide button at the right of the dashboard header for its filter cards, and their state at open (decisions/160)

action_hints.description: true writes the default hint ('Click to filter') after the subtitle of each action's source block; off by default (decisions/183). An action's own 'hint' is always written

actions.description: Actions: a click (or hover) on the source sheet's marks/rows filters or highlights the target sheets, opens a link or sets a parameter; each is signed in the source block's subtitle

profile.description: The user profile (profiles/<name>, a name, not a path; decisions/193): the defaults of this book; --profile is stronger, explicit fields of the spec are stronger than the profile

dashboards.description: Several dashboards over the same sheets, filters and calcs (decisions/040), instead of one 'dashboard'. Each is a dashboard object; the first opens with the workbook. The shell (sidebar, topbar, theme, theme_font, accent, data_as_of) is the same on all of them

nav.description: Navigation between the dashboards (decisions/040): a goto button per dashboard on every dashboard, the current one highlighted

style.description: tabs: a row of tabs at the top, the current one underlined in the accent color (Citizen Service); sidebar: buttons in the dashboard sidebar under its title, the current one on a white face (Admissions)

items.description: Order and captions of the buttons: every dashboard once; default all dashboards in order, captioned by name

declutter.description: Hide gridlines, zero lines, axis rulers/ticks and table dividers on every sheet (reference-author style)

block_headers.description: Sheet title/subtitle drawn as a text block above the sheet on the dashboard (reference-author style); a sheet with neither has no header. false = Tableau's own worksheet title (sheet name or 'title'), kept for the early goldens

calcs.description: Calculated fields. Formula subset: numbers, "strings", [Field] (CSV column or another calc), + - * /, comparisons, AND/OR/NOT, IF/ELSEIF/ELSE/END, CASE/WHEN/ELSE/END, SUM AVG MIN MAX COUNT COUNTD, ZN ABS ROUND, DATETRUNC DATEADD, LODs, parameters ([Name] or [Parameters].[Name]), table calculation functions RANK RANK_DENSE WINDOW_SUM WINDOW_AVG WINDOW_MAX WINDOW_MIN LOOKUP RUNNING_SUM TOTAL INDEX FIRST LAST (with compute_using). Use the calc name wherever a field name is expected; aggregate calcs (e.g. SUM([Profit])/SUM([Sales])) are used as measures without 'agg'.

datasource.description: With datasources (decisions/083): the source whose columns the formula uses; default the first

folder.description: The Data pane folder the calc sits in (decisions/146); default none. A field is in one folder

good.description: An aggregate change calc shown in an insight line or a KPI tile note as '▲ 11.4%' / '▼ 60.3%', in the good or bad text color (up: a rise is good; decisions/139)

compute_using.description: Required for a formula with table calculation functions (decisions/034): the sheet dimensions it runs along, in order (Tableau 'Specific Dimensions'); the other dimensions of the sheet partition it. Every sheet that shows the calc must have these dimensions

parameters.description: Parameters (decisions/020): a metric switch, the N of a Top N, a period level. Used by name: [Name] or [Parameters].[Name] in calc formulas (CASE [Metric] WHEN "Sales" THEN SUM([Sales]) ... END; DATETRUNC([Period], [Date])), top.n of a bar, [Name] in a title or subtitle (shows the current value). Each gets a control card in the dashboard header row.

fields.description: Field properties (decisions/033), by field name: aliases of the members, their manual order, a group, their default colors. Keys of aliases / order / color are the values in the data (a group's: its bin names and 'other'). A group is a new field named by its key, used like a column.

sheet.description: excel: the sheet with the table, the only block of cells on it, header in its first row (decisions/025, 050)

union.description: excel: more sheets with the same columns, appended under 'sheet'; Desktop adds the columns 'Sheet' and 'Table Name' (decisions/050)

on.description: key column, the same name on both sheets

join.description: excel: the columns of a second sheet joined to 'sheet' by a key; a column named like one of 'sheet' becomes '<name> (<sheet>)' (decisions/050)

hyper.description: csv: package the data as a Hyper extract (true) or as the CSV (false); omitted: Hyper when the CSV is larger than the build's threshold (decisions/026)

folder.description: The Data pane folder the field sits in (decisions/146); default none. A column of the data or a calc (same as the calc's own folder), not a group; with datasources the folder is in every source that has the field

caption.description: The column's name in the workbook (decisions/073): what table headers, filter cards and tooltips show instead of the data's name ('customer_tier' -> 'Customer Tier'); the spec keeps using the data's name. Any column of the data, not a calc or a group

aliases.description: value in the data -> label Tableau shows ('19 Mon' -> 'Mon'); formulas and filters keep the values

order.description: every value of the field, in the order the sheets show them (Mon..Sun, Low/Medium/High)

color.description: value -> #rrggbb, or a design token name (accent, good, bad, warn, muted, mark_muted), for every value of the field: its color wherever the field is on Color

field.description: the text or integer column, or the row-level text calculation, whose members are grouped (decisions/151)

bins.description: bin name -> its members; a member belongs to one bin

other.description: name of every member out of the bins ('Other'); omitted: they keep their own names

brandSidebar.description: Brand sidebar (decisions/029): the grey sidebar's title and filters on the brand color, plus a logo, export buttons and a footer

text.description: Text color; default white or dark, whichever contrasts more

image.description: Picture next to the spec (.png/.jpg/.gif/.bmp), packaged in the .twbx

download.description: Export buttons: the whole dashboard as PDF, PowerPoint or a picture

footer.description: Lines at the bottom: 'Created by ...', 'Data source: ...'

topbar.description: App bar over the whole dashboard (decisions/029): the app name, optionally 'Welcome, <user>' (FULLNAME())

text.description: Text color; default white or dark, whichever contrasts more

title.description: App name; ** marks bold words, otherwise all bold

topSeries.description: Only the top (end: bottom) N members of the sheet's own dimension by its measure: a line / area's series (its 'color' field), a table's row field (one), a heatmap's rows. Tableau Top N filter, computed before the dimension filters (decisions/148)

oneOf.description: An integer parameter: the control in the header sets N

by.description: Rank by this measure instead of the sheet's (decisions/067)

end.description: bottom: the N smallest members (Filter > Top > Bottom, ascending); not with 'after' (decisions/148)

type.description: string: one of 'values' (dropdown); integer / real: a number in 'range' (slider) or one of 'values' (dropdown); date: an ISO date in 'range' {min, max} (a date card) or one of 'values'; boolean: true / false, no values or range (decisions/057)

aliases.description: List parameters only: {value: label}, the label the dropdown / radio list shows for that value (<member alias=... value=.../>); formulas still see the value. A value that is not in 'values' is refused (decisions/148)

step.description: integer / real only; a date range has no step

default.description: The value when the workbook opens: one of 'values', or a step of 'range' (a date: YYYY-MM-DD)

values_from.description: A list read from this CSV column when the workbook opens (Tableau 2020.1+ dynamic parameter, Desktop's source-field; decisions/163): its values in the data, re-read at every open. Instead of 'values' / 'range'; a column of the parameter's type; no aliases

default_from.description: The value when the workbook opens from a calc (Desktop's default-value-field; decisions/163): a calc of one value over the whole data, a FIXED LOD without dimensions such as {MAX([Order Date])}, without parameters, of the parameter's type. Instead of 'default'

control.description: Its control in the dashboard header row (decisions/042): card = a dropdown (string) or a slider (integer); radio = a radio button per value (string); none = no card. Default: none when a buttons sheet sets the parameter, else card

period.description: A period switch (decisions/042, SuperMart L6M ... All): every sheet keeps the rows of the selected period up to the last date of the data. Values: L<N> with D, W, M, Q or Y (L6M = the last 6 whole months, the last date's month included) and All

sheetFilters.description: The sheet's own filters (decisions/057), not shared with the other sheets and without a card: a filter of values on a text column or a text / boolean calc (default, exclude), or a filter on an aggregate (min / max of agg(field), or of an aggregate calc), applied to each mark of the sheet after the dimension filters

default.description: The values the sheet keeps (true / false of a boolean calc)

exclude.description: default lists the value left out

min.description: Marks whose aggregate is at least this

max.description: Marks whose aggregate is at most this

objectName.description: Sheet/dashboard name; no XML- or Tableau-reference-unsafe characters

isoDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, whatever the CSV's date format

show_on.description: Sheet on the dashboard that owns the filter card

mode.description: values: a filter of a text field's values, its card a multiple-values dropdown (checkdropdown) in the header or sidebar, a multiple-values list (multi_list) in the right panel; checkdropdown / single_dropdown (one value, an HTML <select>) / single_list (one value, radio buttons, right panel) / single_slider (one value, a slider; header or sidebar) / multi_list: the same filter with that card; wildcard: a text box that keeps the values matching 'pattern' (a search box, decisions/162); range: date range of a date field (min..max inclusive, without them the whole range), or a measure range of a number column with numeric min and max (row-level values, decisions/162); relative: the last N periods of a date field up to 'anchor'

pattern.description: wildcard: the text typed in the card when the workbook opens; without it the card is empty and keeps every value

match.description: wildcard: how pattern matches a value

apply.description: The card has an Apply button (Tableau 'Show Apply Button'): the selection changes the sheets only on Apply. A multiple-values card (values / checkdropdown / multi_list)

default.description: Values selected when the workbook opens (an HTML select or preset with a chosen value); without it (All). A single_* card takes one value. On a boolean calc: true / false (decisions/057)

relevant.description: The card lists only the values relevant to the other filters (cascading filters: Region -> City)

exclude.description: default lists the values left out; the others and values added to the data later pass

context.description: Context filter: applied before Top N and FIXED (top 10 within the selected region); other filters after them

scope.description: A book with several dashboards (decisions/071): dashboard (the default) filters the sheets of the dashboard its card (show_on) stands on, and of any dashboard sharing a sheet with it; workbook filters every sheet, its card on every dashboard (040). A date or context filter needs workbook

sheets.description: Only these sheets (decisions/074, Tableau 'Apply to selected worksheets'): an HTML filter that changes one block and leaves the others; show_on is one of them, its card stands on every dashboard showing one. Not with scope workbook; not on a date or context filter

min.description: range: first date shown (with max), YYYY-MM-DD; on a datetime field also YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM[:SS] (decisions/051); a number on a measure range (the lowest row value kept, decisions/162)

max.description: range: last date shown (with min), its whole day; with HH:MM[:SS] (datetime field) up to that moment; a number on a measure range (the highest row value kept)

last.description: relative: how many periods, the anchor's period included (1 = this month, 3 = last 3 months)

anchor.description: relative: the date counted back from (Tableau 'Anchor relative to'); default: the latest date in the data at build time

relativeFilter.description: period / last / anchor belong to mode 'relative'

highlight.description: Muted base with an accent: these values of 'field' in the accent color, the others muted; no legend (name the colors in the subtitle: {accent:East})

field.description: Text dimension whose values are highlighted; bar default: its dimension; line/area: required (the series)

reference.description: Reference line (decisions/028): dashed, muted, labelled '<label> <value>' ('Average 76'). avg / median of the marks in the view (a stacked bar: of the bar totals), const = 'value', param = a numeric parameter; date = a solid vertical line on the date axis of a line/area at the day 'value', labelled with its text only (SOC 'Jun 1st'); band = a pale fill between 'from' and 'to' (decisions/043); target = a solid line across each bar at its own 'measure', no label (a bar of members, decisions/095; with color {below: target} the bars below it in the bad color; with 'bands' a bullet graph, decisions/152)

oneOf.description: const: where the line is drawn

from.description: band only: the lower edge, a number or an integer parameter

to.description: band only: the upper edge, a number or an integer parameter; above 'from'

parameter.description: param only: an integer parameter; its control in the header moves the line

measure.description: target: each bar's target (required). avg / median only: average this measure over the marks instead of the sheet's own ('weekday avg': a calc that is null on weekends); default: the sheet's measure

label.description: Text before the value; default Average / Median / Target / the parameter name

bands.description: target only: a bullet graph (decisions/152) - zones under each bar at these percents of its own target, rising ([80, 95]: below 80 %, 80-95 %, above 95 %), gray from dark to light; name them in the subtitle

benchmark.description: The selected member against all members (decisions/043, SOC Monitor): two lines, the selected in the accent color, the benchmark muted; the benchmark is a FIXED LOD per period (the sum over all members / their count, or for agg avg the average of all rows), so no filter or parameter changes it. Name the colors in the subtitle: {accent:Selected region}

field.description: Text dimension whose member is selected (Region)

oneOf.description: A value of field, or "filter": the dashboard filter on field (single_dropdown, one default) selects it

parameter.description: A string parameter over values of field

against.description: The benchmark: every member of field

label.description: The benchmark's name in the expected numbers (default 'All <field> avg')

totals.description: Grand totals and subtotals (decisions/036): a total is the measure over the rows of its partition, not the sum of the cells

grand.description: rows: a total row under the rows; cols: a total column right of the columns (table only); both: the two and their corner

sub.description: Registry with two rows: a 'Total' row after each member of the outer dimension

label.description: Label of the grand total row / column

tooltip.description: The sheet's tooltip phrase (decisions/036): fields as <Region> (on the sheet) or <SUM(Sales)>, <AVG(Profit)>, <AGG(calc)>; a measure not on the sheet goes on its Tooltip shelf; \n breaks the line

colorScale.description: The measure on Color with a continuous scale from the design tokens (decisions/041)

scale.description: sequential: light grey to the accent; diverging: bad, neutral grey at 'center', good

palette.description: accent for sequential, good_bad for diverging (the default of each)

good.description: diverging: values above the center are good (up) or bad (down)

steps.description: Stepped color: that many color steps instead of a smooth scale

min.description: A fixed start of the range (within the data: lighter marks below it saturate)

max.description: A fixed end of the range (within the data)

center.description: diverging (required): the value drawn neutral, e.g. 0 for a change

mapColor.description: A map's marks on a continuous color scale (decisions/137): the colorScale of a heatmap (decisions/041) by the map's measure, or by color.measure. Sequential starts 30% of the way to the accent (the Light map's land is the scale's light end); diverging is a heatmap's

measure.description: A second measure on Color (the map's measure keeps the size and the labels); default the map's measure

source.description: Sheet on the dashboard whose marks/rows are clicked (bar, line, area, table, heatmap or registry)

targets.description: "all" = every other sheet of the dashboard (default), or the sheets to filter

type.description: filter (decisions/017), highlight (tsc:brush), url (open a link), parameter (set a parameter to the clicked member) — decisions/160

on.description: select / hover; menu (the link in the tooltip menu) for url only; parameter: select only

url.description: type url: the link; <Field> is the clicked mark's value of a dimension of the source sheet

parameter.description: type parameter: the string parameter with a list of values the click sets

field.description: type parameter: the dimension of the source sheet whose clicked member the parameter gets

fields.description: Filter only by these dimensions of the source sheet (Tableau 'Selected fields'); default: all of them

clear.description: filter: show_all (default) / exclude — when the selection is cleared, show all values again or nothing in the targets; parameter: the value the parameter gets when the selection is cleared (default: it keeps the clicked one)

hint.description: Text after the source block's subtitle ('Click a region to filter'); the default text (per type: decisions/160) is written only with dashboard.action_hints

agg.description: Default sum; must be omitted for aggregate calculated fields

scale.description: A log axis (polish-26): scatter x / y, strip, beeswarm, bar

per.description: cards only: the measure is SUM(field) / SUM(per) of a period (Profit per Sales = margin); its change is in percentage points (+1.6 pp), not a percent, unless delta 'pct'

per_agg.description: cards only, with per (decisions/198): how per adds up over a period; countd of invoices under revenue is an average order value

label.description: Caption shown on a KPI tile (default: field name); on a bar/line/area it is a name of the measure the block header may say, so the axis title that repeats it is hidden

heading.description: cards only: the name line of the KPI tile when it should say a parameter, e.g. 'Top [Top N] sales'; each [Parameter] shows its current value. 'label' stays the plain name (calc captions); default: label (decisions/148)

axis_title.description: bar/line/area only: 'none' hides the title of the measure axis whatever the block header says (decisions/136); without it the title goes only when the header repeats the measure (colors.repeats)

table_calc.description: Quick table calculation on this measure (sheet with dimensions only). 'along' = the sheet dimensions to compute along (Tableau 'Specific Dimensions'); the other sheet dimensions partition the result. Default: all sheet dimensions (whole table).

good.description: cards only: which direction of change is good (Avg days to close: down)

delta.description: cards only (decisions/169): the change of this measure as a percent ('▲ 12.5%') or absolute in its own format ('▲ 3' of a count); a ratio ('per') changes in percentage points unless given 'pct' (decisions/198)

goal.description: cards only, with history 'line' right of the number (decisions/178): the measure's goal, a dashed line on the sparkline without a label and ' · goal 95%' after the change

delta_format.description: cards only, with delta 'abs' (decisions/177): the change's own number format; default: the measure's format, of an average (agg not sum / count) one decimal more

status.description: KPI cards only (decisions/062): a dot right of the card text colored by thresholds (SOC Monitor). Two thresholds [lo, hi]: at or above hi good, from lo warn, below lo bad (good 'down': at or below lo good, up to hi warn, above hi bad); one threshold: good or bad. Its legend is a line of a header (status_legend)

on.description: value: the card's number against thresholds in its units (a target 15000: [13500, 15000]); change: the card's change against the base period as a fraction ([-0.05, 0])

target.description: KPI cards only (decisions/155): the card's target for its current period; the card text says '103% of $15.0K target' and a progress bar under it fills to the share (full and in the good color at or over the target; bad for good 'down'). Every measure of the sheet has one

value.description: a constant target in the measure's units

field.description: a numeric column with the target (plan) per row, aggregated over the current period like the card's value

agg.description: with field: its aggregate, default sum

note.description: kpi tiles only (decisions/045): a line under the tile's number, a phrase with [Calc]: '[Incidents Share] of total'

insight.description: A phrase with aggregate calcs in brackets, under the block header (decisions/045): 'Busiest day: **[Peak Day] ([Peak Day Closures])**; weekend adds only [Weekend Closures].' Tableau shows each [Calc] (following the filters); ** marks the bold parts

numberFormat.description: Number format of the field (decisions/032): its default-format, so every sheet shows it the same way. A preset or {type, decimals, units, symbol, negative}.

datasource.description: With datasources (decisions/083): the name of the source this sheet takes its fields from; default the first

title.description: Block header shown above the sheet on the dashboard, 14pt; ** marks bold key words as in the dashboard title (with block_headers false: Tableau's worksheet title, default sheet name)

subtitle.description: Grey 9pt hint under the block title ('click to filter', what a mark is); needs block_headers. Legend as colored words: {accent:East}, {good:above plan}, {bad:below plan} are drawn bold in a color the sheet draws (color.highlight, color.good, plan, KPI cards)

then.description: Dual axis (decisions/044, ER Operation): bars of one measure by a dimension (muted, labelled), a line of another on the second axis (accent, its axis hidden); the axes are synchronized when both measures are in one unit (the same field, or one explicit number format)

date_level.description: The dimension is a date: a bar per period, the line across the periods (a case AI traffic, decisions/140)

then.description: Dual axis pie (decisions/044, SuperMart, E-Commerce): the measure's shares by the dimension as a ring, its total in the centre, and a legend sheet beside it: 'member value (share)'. Up to 5 members (lint C2)

color.description: Muted ring with an accent: these members of the dimension in the accent color, the others muted. Written as fields.<dimension>.color (every sheet with the dimension on Color shows it); 'field' is the dimension

then.description: Dual axis (decisions/139, SOC 'Line - Uptime'): per member a muted span from 'from' to 'to' (a Gantt bar sized by the change) and an accent circle at 'to' with its value, horizontal, one synchronized scale

zero.description: false: the axis spans the values, not from zero (Include zero off, polish-26b); the range stays automatic, a filter moves it

then.description: Slope chart (decisions/141): a line per member between the two periods the sheet's filter on period keeps (default [before, after]), the member and its value at both ends; good / bad by the change, or color.highlight accent and the rest muted

period.description: A text dimension (a year as STR(YEAR(...)) calc): its two kept values on Columns

highlight.description: Members in the accent, the rest muted: {accent:...} in the subtitle

labels.description: cull: Tableau hides a label that would overlap another; spread: every member's label at both ends, moved apart where values are close (a second synchronized axis of label positions, polish-26b; up to 12 members)

then.description: Box plot (decisions/141, Higher Education 'Box Plot - Time'): a row per member, Tableau's box (quartiles, median, whiskers 1.5 IQR) over a dot per detail member

detail.description: A text row id: a dot each

points.description: Every dot; false: only the outliers

then.description: Waffle (decisions/141, a reference): 10 x 10 squares, the share of part in the measure filled in the accent, the rest light grey; square cells sized from the zone, no scrollbar (polish-26b)

cells.description: A numeric row id with every value 1..100: a square each

value.description: true: the share as a big % in the block, over the squares (the sheet's title with the share field, polish-26b)

then.description: Tile grid (decisions/154): a square tile per member of dimension, colored by the measure, its code and value on it. layout {row, col}: a tile map, the tile's place from two numeric columns of the data (reference 'US Tile Map'); layout {cols}: a wall, the members by the measure descending, cols to a row (reference: INDEX() % cols), in blocks side by side by group

label.description: The short name on the tile (a state's code); default the member

row.description: A numeric column: the tile's row, 1 at the top

col.description: A numeric column: the tile's column, 1 at the left

cols.description: A wall: tiles to a row

group.description: A wall's blocks: a block of cols columns per member, its name over it

then.description: A bar per bin of a numeric column, its height the count of rows (decisions/140, HelpDesk RWFD 'DAYS OPEN')

count.description: About this many bins over the column's range (a round width)

then.description: A dot per member of detail at its measure, spread by a fixed jitter (INDEX() along detail), a row per dimension member (decisions/140)

detail.description: A text row id: a dot each (a numeric id as a STR() calc)

dimension.description: A row of dots per member

then.description: A strip whose dots of one bin of the measure stack outward from the middle line, no overlaps (decisions/140)

detail.description: A text row id: a dot each

dimension.description: A row of dots per member

count.description: About this many bins over the column's range (a round width)

then.description: A square per day, weekday rows under month / week columns, colored by the measure on the house sequential scale; a sheet filter keeps one year (decisions/140)

The rank of each member per period (RANK along the dimension), a line with a dot per period, rank 1 on top, highlighted members in the accent, the rest muted, the name at the line's end (decisions/140)

highlight.description: Members in the accent; name them in the subtitle: {accent:...}

then.description: Waterfall (decisions/139, Higher Education Admissions): a Gantt bar per member from the running total before it to the one after it, good / bad by the step's sign, the step as its label

total.description: A last bar 'Total' from 0 to the sum, muted (decisions/144, reference <cols total='true'>)

then.description: Pareto (decisions/157, reference 'Advanced Pareto Chart'): bars of the measure by the dimension, largest first, the running share of the total as a line on a 0-100 % axis on the right, a dashed line at the threshold; the vital few (the running share before them under the threshold) in the accent

threshold.description: The share of the total the reference line marks (0.8 = the 80/20 rule)

highlight.description: true: the vital few bars in the accent, the rest muted, the line muted; false: every bar muted, the line in the accent

then.description: Funnel (decisions/159, reference 'Funnel with Gantt bars'): a stage per row, a level bar centered on zero as long as its value, the conversion beside the value

sort.description: desc: by the value; none: the field's order (fields.<dim>.order for the process order)

conversion.description: previous: over the stage before it; first: over the first stage; none: the value only

then.description: Gantt / timeline (polish-26, AdsCampaignsOverview): a bar per task from its start date for DATEDIFF('day', start, end) days, colored by a status with fields.<color>.color

color.description: A status column; its members' colors in fields.<color>.color

then.description: Dual axis (decisions/044, Admissions): a thin muted stick and an accent circle with the value per member, horizontal; both axes hidden

Scatter plot (decisions/047, NovaCart): a circle per member of the detail dimension at (x, y), both measures aggregated per member; accent points unless colored; optional dashed lines across both axes at the average (median) of the points and a linear trend line

detail.description: Text dimension: one point per member (on Detail)

oneOf.description: A dimension: Tableau's palette and legend; a point per detail x color member
A measure: the house sequential scale

highlight.description: Members of detail drawn in the accent color, the others muted (no legend: {accent:...} in the subtitle)

axis_lines.description: A dashed muted line across each axis at the average (median) of the points, labelled '<label> <value>' ('Avg: 17.8')

label.description: Text before the value; default Average / Median

trend.description: A linear trend line over all points, muted

then.description: Treemap (decisions/138), packed bubbles (bubbles, decisions/141: the same as circles): a rectangle per member of label, its area the size measure, nested in group; the house sequential scale by the size (scale_low -> accent) unless color.highlight; labels that do not fit are hidden

size.description: Measure on Size: the area of a rectangle (and its color, without color.highlight)

label.description: Dimension: a rectangle per member, its text

group.description: Dimension one level up (on Detail): the rectangles of a member stay together

value.description: The size measure as a second line of the label

highlight.description: Members of group (of label without a group) in the accent color, the others muted (no legend: {accent:...} in the subtitle)

then.description: Map on Tableau's built-in geocoding (decisions/046): a circle per place sized by the measure (symbol, Admissions, Cutest Financial) or the place's polygon colored by it on the house sequential scale (filled, Superstore); light background. Every value of the geo field must be a name Desktop geocodes (checked before the build). Under 3 places: lint G1 (bars read better)

geo.description: Built-in geocoding {field, role, country?}, or the data's coordinates {field, lat, lon}

field.description: Text column of place names (with lat / lon: of the places the points are)

lat.description: Numeric latitude column (-90..90), one value per place; Tableau role [Geographical].[Latitude], AVG on Rows

country.description: state / city only, required: the country the names are looked up in ('United States'); one per workbook

measure.description: symbol: the circle size; filled: the color

style.description: filled: country or state only (Tableau has no city polygons)

labels.description: The measure's value on each mark, overlapping labels hidden

size.description: symbol only: false draws every circle the same size (then a color scale carries the measure; decisions/137)

then.description: A button per value of a string parameter (decisions/042, SuperMart): a click sets the parameter; the current value in the accent, the others muted

arrange.description: side by side (period tabs) or stacked (a list of metrics)

then.description: Dynamic zone visibility (decisions/042, 082): one cell that shows the sheet of the parameter's current value; the views are bar, line, area, table, heatmap or registry sheets placed nowhere else in the grid; with datasources the switch takes its views' datasource

views.description: {parameter value: sheet name}, one per value of the parameter

style.description: tiles: one big-number tile per measure, side by side; cards: per measure the latest period's value, its change against the base period (colored by 'good') and a history of the measure by period (needs 'date')

date.description: cards only: the date field and the period of a card (latest period in the data)

anchor.description: cards only (polish-26): the period of the latest date, or the latest whole period (the latest date is its last day; a part-filled current period is left out)

compare.description: cards only: base of the change - the previous period (MoM) or the same period a year back (YoY)

arrange.description: tiles/cards: side by side (row) or stacked (column; a card then puts its value left of its history); strip = side by side in one card with a 1px divider between the measures (theme 'cards' only)

history_reference.description: cards only: a reference line over each card's history bars (Call Center 'Average')

history_color.description: cards only: history bars that got better than the period before in the good color, worse in the bad color, the rest muted (by the measure's 'good'); replaces the accent on the current bar

delta.description: cards only (decisions/037): the change as a percent ('▲ 10.5% MoM') or as the absolute change with its arrow and then the percent ('▲ 1,466 | 10.5% MoM'); the absolute change takes the measure's format

delta_style.description: cards only: the change as a colored line of the card text, or a pill under it: bold text on a pale fill in the good / bad color

history.description: cards only: the history as bars (the current one in the accent) or a sparkline with only its max and its last value labelled; area: the sparkline over its pale fill (decisions/088); history_reference draws the dashed average over either

history_months.description: cards with a sparkline by month (decisions/088): the months under it as one letter, J F M (as in the reference)

history_points_legend.description: with history_points (decisions/088): their legend '● Max ● Min' once as a line under the block's title, not on every card (needs the title or subtitle; the measures agree on 'good')

base_value.description: cards only (decisions/088): the base period's value as a number after the change, '▲ 10.5% | $14.0K Last Month' (reference '78,038 Last Year')

history_points.description: cards with history 'line' or 'area' only (decisions/059): a dot on the sparkline at its max (good color), min (bad; swapped for good 'down') and last period (accent), a second layer on the line's axis; a period that is two of them takes the first listed

history_point_labels.description: with history_points: the value next to each dot (off: dots only, the line unlabelled)

progress.description: cards whose measures have a target (decisions/155): the progress bar as the fill over a pale track of its thickness (bar), or over a thin track line (thin)

marker.description: cards only: a 4px bar left of each card's text in the good / bad color by the sign of the change

period_line.description: cards only, one sheet per spec: 'Dec 2025 compared to Nov 2025' once under the dashboard header (needs a dashboard title, no sidebar); 'header': in the header row at its right, and the cards without their date line; 'card': the date under each card's name instead of above it (decisions/169)

history_place.description: cards only (decisions/169): the history under the card text, or a small one right of the value

delta_zero.description: cards only (decisions/169): a zero change counts as good (sign) or is grey '= no change' (neutral)

card_date.description: cards only, with period_line 'card' (decisions/177): the period's date under each card's name; without it the card has no date line, the change line says against what. 'range' (decisions/178, date level week, compare previous): 'wk 12 (19–24 Oct) vs wk 11'

separate_cards.description: cards only, with history_place 'right', period_line 'card', arrange 'row' and no title (decisions/178): each measure its own white card with its border, the canvas between them

delta_colors.description: cards only, with delta_zero 'neutral' (decisions/178): a worse change in the accent, a better one and no change dark grey, no green; the last sparkline point likewise

status_labels.description: cards with a measure status (decisions/062): the good, warn and bad status names, in the legend and the status calc (SOC: Healthy, Warning, Critical)

status_legend.description: cards with a measure status: the legend of the statuses as a line of this block's header (needs its title or subtitle), of the dashboard header, or none (another block's legend names the same statuses; lint K4)

facet.description: Small multiples (decisions/141): a panel per member of field side by side, its name over the panel, one shared axis

date_level.description: The dimension is a date: a bar per period (discrete truncation, headers 'Jan' for months), stacked by a color field (decisions/090)

oneOf.description: A dimension on Color: Tableau's palette and a legend

good.description: Bars by the sign of the measure: in the good color when >= 0 (up) or <= 0 (down), else in the bad color

vs.description: Bars at or above the average of the bars in the accent color, the others muted (ER Patients vs Waiting Time); name it in the subtitle: {accent:above average}

below.description: Bars below their reference line 'target' in the bad color, the others muted (reference 'Color vs. Target', decisions/095); name it in the subtitle: {bad:below target}

total.description: A stacked horizontal bar (color by a field): the stack total right of each bar, the axis hidden (reference 'Stacked with End Labels', decisions/095); not with a reference line

parts.description: Bar-in-bar (decisions/156, reference 'Ungrouped Stacked'): the member's total as a wide muted bar, the parts of 'color' (a field) side by side inside it in their colors; values at the bar ends, the axes hidden; orientation vertical only

value_column.description: A horizontal bar of members: its value as a second row header, right-aligned beside the member, the bar without a label and the axis hidden (reference 'Labels on the Left', decisions/095)

plan.description: Plan as a wide muted bar behind the fact (fact in the accent color); no 'color' with it

labels.description: end: each bar's value at its end and no axis (reference 'Labels on the End'); the default of a horizontal bar of members without a color stack, a plan, a date_level or a target reference (a line across all the bars keeps its own label: decisions/165). none: the axis instead of labels (decisions/087)

legend.description: The color legend as a line of the block header (bar / line / area colored by a field with fields.<field>.color): a colored square and the label per member, no legend column (decisions/045). Object form (decisions/173): position header (default) | below (a text zone under the block), groups [{label, values}] = one line per group, every member of fields.<field>.color once

top.description: Only the top N bars by the measure (Tableau Top N filter, computed before the dimension filters)

oneOf.description: An integer parameter: the control in the header sets N

end.description: bottom: the N smallest members (Filter > Top > Bottom, ascending); not with 'after' (decisions/148)

by.description: Rank by this measure instead of the sheet's (Filter > Top > By field; a public book's State Wise (%): the top 5 states by SUM(Sales) showing their % change, decisions/067). Not on the sheet: Desktop declares its column, no instance

after.description: Rank the marks after every filter (a RANK table calc of the measure filtered to 1..N, a public book's Sales by City: the top 5 cities of the United States), not before the dimension filters. A tie at the N-th place keeps every tied bar. n a number from 2, no 'by' (decisions/086)

facet.description: Small multiples (decisions/141): a panel per member of field side by side, its name over the panel, one shared axis; cols N (decisions/144): N panels a row, the member named at its line's end

annotate.description: Label the N largest values only (polish-26)

step.description: A step line: the value held until the next period, a vertical jump at each change (line-interpolation step, two Tableau Public step line books)

labels.description: Label the line ends (decisions/043): its last value (SOC), or its first and last (Call Center); every series. A line split by color reads 'series value' (decisions/170); an overlapping label is not drawn

zero.description: Include zero. Default: off for a share, a percent, a mean or a ratio (AVG / MEDIAN, a calc with '/'), on for a sum or a count (decisions/170)

min.description: A fixed range from min to max (with max); every value must fall inside it

axis.description: The value axis (decisions/170): Include zero, or a fixed range (Edit Axis: Fixed); not with benchmark

repeat.description: Small multiples (decisions/043): one copy of the sheet per measure ('<name> · <label>', title '<title> **<label>**'), the subtitle (shared legend) on the first only; replaces 'measure'

columns.description: repeat only: the copies as a grid group of this many per row (2 = a 2x2 for four measures); default all side by side in the sheet's row

axis_title.description: 'none' hides the date axis title ('Month of Order Date') under dated ticks (polish-26)

oneOf.description: A dimension on Color: one series per value, Tableau's palette and a legend

legend.description: The color legend as a line of the block header (bar / line / area colored by a field with fields.<field>.color): a colored square and the label per member, no legend column (decisions/045). Object form (decisions/173): position header (default) | below (a text zone under the block), groups [{label, values}] = one line per group, every member of fields.<field>.color once

oneOf.description: Two row fields nest: [outer, inner] (an analyst and the team beside it, decisions/045)

legend.description: The color legend as a line of the block header (bar / line / area colored by a field with fields.<field>.color): a colored square and the label per member, no legend column (decisions/045). Object form (decisions/173): position header (default) | below (a text zone under the block), groups [{label, values}] = one line per group, every member of fields.<field>.color once

sort.description: The rows by their row total (decisions/045): the outer row field sorted by the measure over the columns

facet.description: Small multiples (decisions/141): a panel per member of field side by side, its name over the panel, one shared axis; cols N (decisions/144): N panels a row, the member named at its line's end

annotate.description: Label the N largest values only (polish-26)

step.description: A step area (decisions/158): the value held until the next period, a vertical jump at each change; Bars as wide as the period side by side (reference 'Stepped Area Chart'); labels: last only

labels.description: Label the area's last value (or its first and last), as on a line (decisions/043, 158)

axis_title.description: 'none' hides the date axis title ('Month of Order Date') under dated ticks (polish-26)

oneOf.description: A dimension on Color: one series per value, Tableau's palette and a legend

legend.description: The color legend as a line of the block header (bar / line / area colored by a field with fields.<field>.color): a colored square and the label per member, no legend column (decisions/045). Object form (decisions/173): position header (default) | below (a text zone under the block), groups [{label, values}] = one line per group, every member of fields.<field>.color once

field_labels.description: 'none' hides the field labels over the row and column headers ('Year of Status date'): the block header names the cut (polish-26)

oneOf.description: Two row fields nest as [outer, inner]: the outer header bold once over its inner rows (a warehouse over its waves, decisions/171), a gap between the outer groups (decisions/186)

min.description: only cells whose measure is >= min carry their number, in the measure's own units (10 for a percent x 100)

label.description: Cell labels of the outliers only (decisions/171): a label calc IF <measure> >= min THEN <measure> END on Text; the other cells show their color alone

date_level.description: cols is a date: a column per period (discrete truncation, headers 'Jan' for months), no column margin (decisions/125)

margins.description: Marginal totals (decisions/041): each row's total as a bar at the right, each column's above the cells, with an average line

legend.description: The color legend as a line of the block header (bar / line / area colored by a field with fields.<field>.color): a colored square and the label per member, no legend column (decisions/045). Object form (decisions/173): position header (default) | below (a text zone under the block), groups [{label, values}] = one line per group, every member of fields.<field>.color once

The color legend as a line of the block header (bar / line / area colored by a field with fields.<field>.color): a colored square and the label per member, no legend column (decisions/045). Object form (decisions/173): position header (default) | below (a text zone under the block), groups [{label, values}] = one line per group, every member of fields.<field>.color once

header.description: The column titles on a band of this color, as the HTML table's header (th background; decisions/079); without it the titles stand on the page

color.description: Band color: the th background in the HTML

text.description: Title color (the th color); default white or dark, whichever contrasts more (lint C8)

bar_color.description: Color of the bar_inside bars and the track's share instead of the accent, as the HTML draws its in-cell bars (decisions/079); the white value inside must read on it (lint C8)

repeat.description: A template: one registry per dimension ('<name> · <dim>', rows [dim]); its dashboard cell becomes a cell per dimension in the same row (decisions/039)

top.description: Only the top N rows by the first column's measure, or by top.by (one row dimension; Tableau Top N filter)

oneOf.description: An integer parameter: the control in the header sets N

end.description: bottom: the N smallest members (Filter > Top > Bottom, ascending); not with 'after' (decisions/148)

by.description: Rank by this measure instead of the sheet's (Filter > Top > By field; a public book's State Wise (%): the top 5 states by SUM(Sales) showing their % change, decisions/067). Not on the sheet: Desktop declares its column, no instance

style.description: bar: grey bar with the value on it; text: the value only; rank: RANK of the measure within the outer group; share: % of the table total; bar_inside: accent bar, value inside (outside, dark, when its bar is too short; decisions/077); track: share bar on a 100% track (one per registry); dot: dot colored by the measure, value right of it; tick: bar with a tick at 'base'; delta: change vs 'base' with an arrow, good/bad color (decisions/039); spark: a mini-trend of block glyphs, needs 'spark'; pill: the measure's level as a label on a pale fill, needs 'levels' (decisions/096)

shape.description: dot: a status mark instead of the dot, Tableau's filled triangle up / down or circle by the sign of the measure, good / bad / muted by 'good' (decisions/139)

spark.description: spark: the measure (summed, or its 'agg') per period of a date field, 'count' periods from 'from'; a row with no rows in a period counts 0 (decisions/096)

from.description: Start of the first period (the first day of the month / quarter / year)

count.description: Periods: 2..12 as glyphs, 2..60 as a line

form.description: Default: line where the registry takes one, else glyphs (decisions/164). glyphs: block glyphs in the cell (decisions/096); line: the measure per period as a line, the last period a dot, each row on its own scale, on a sheet right of the registry; the last column, one row dimension, no totals or top (decisions/153)

levels.description: pill: from the lowest level up; the lowest has no 'from', each next one starts at its 'from' (value >= from); a null value takes the lowest (decisions/096)

base.description: tick / delta: the measure compared with (previous period calc, plan)

second.description: text: a second line under the value, 8pt muted

of.description: track: the bar as a share of the largest row (WINDOW_MAX) instead of the rows' total (decisions/144)

with_value.description: share: '**21 %** (230)', the share bold and the measure in brackets

good.description: delta: which sign is good; dot: which end of the scale is good (good color) or bad

highlight.description: Cells below/above the threshold get the 'bad' background

total.description: bar / bar_inside in a registry with 'totals' (decisions/081): the total row shows the measure over its rows (a ratio of sums, not a sum of ratios) without a bar, so the rows' bars keep their scale

bar.description: bar columns: draw the total's bar too, where it is no longer than the longest row bar (a ratio or an average); a longer total (a sum) draws its number only. Not on bar_inside (its total is a number without a bar)

format.description: The total's number in its own format: 25.1% under rows of 52%

sort.description: Rows by the first column (within the outer group)

oneOf.description: A group: its own grid inside the cell (e.g. a full-height KPI column next to rows of charts)
